translations.web: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.
translations.bsb: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality, she is unwilling.
translations.kjv: And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not.
translations.asv: And I gave her time that she should repent; and she willeth not to repent of her fornication.
